# Upstream sync — FreqUI 3.1.0 (advisory only)

Upstream release: **[FreqUI 3.1.0](https://github.com/freqtrade/frequi/releases/tag/3.1.0)** (2026-06-29, by @xmatthias).

## TL;DR

3.1.0 adds **Lookahead Analysis** and **Recursive Analysis** views, plus a persistent Analysis-settings store and a navbar layout refresh. It stacks **on top of the 3.0.0 Nuxt UI migration that the fork has not adopted yet** — so this PR ships *no code change*, only this advisory doc.

The fork's strategy decision (PrimeVue stay vs Nuxt UI migration, options A/B/C) is still pending in [PR #31 (`docs(upstream): analyse du gap de sync avec frequi 2.2.4 → 3.0.2`)](../../../pull/31). 3.1.0 doesn't unblock that decision — it widens the gap.

## Why no code change in this PR

The fork (`FreqUI Ultimate`, currently at custom version `0.8.0`) is structurally on **PrimeVue + custom glassmorphism widgets**. Upstream moved to **`@nuxt/ui` v4 + `reka-ui` + `@tanstack/vue-table`** at 3.0.0. The 3.1.0 features are built on top of that stack:

- `UTable` (Nuxt UI table component) used in the recursive-analysis output
- `botStore` background-job handling that was refactored after the 3.0 migration
- New navbar layout that depends on the Nuxt UI shell

Cherry-picking 3.1.0 onto a PrimeVue base would mean re-implementing all of the above in PrimeVue, which is the same effort as starting the migration itself. The right sequencing is:

1. Resolve PR #31's question (option A / B / C for 3.0.0).
2. Once a 3.x baseline exists in the fork, port the 3.1.0 features on top (or absorb them via the `next/` branch from option C).

## Companion backend feature

The matching backend support already landed in **freqtrade 2026.6** (see the companion sync PR in `titouannwtt/freqtrade-fork`):

- `feat: add lookahead analysis API endpoints` (`86f4353`)
- `feat: add recursive analysis api endpoints` (`bfa7b16`)
- `feat: add backgroundjob deletion endpoint` (`e64d680`)
- `feat: delete all background jobs` (`be0573b`)
- `fix: backtesting and analysis can't run in parallel` (`3f61a8c`)

So once the bots are on freqtrade 2026.6 the API surface is available; only the UI side is gated by the Nuxt UI migration.

## Impact on fork-specific code

**None applied in this PR.** When the eventual port happens, the affected fork areas will be:

| Area | Expected impact when 3.1.0 is ported |
|---|---|
| Dashboard / glassmorphism widgets | none — additive views |
| `BotComparisonList.vue` (+4 530 lines) | none |
| `CandleChart.vue` custom tooltip | none |
| StrategyDev (Monaco editor + job launcher) | overlapping with the new bg-job store refactor — review for duplicate state |
| Replay modal (v0.8.0) | none |
| i18n catalogues | will need new keys for the Lookahead / Recursive views |
| `botStore` / `ftbotwrapper` | refactor target (`c560577` moves bg-job handling into the store) — must reconcile with the fork's existing multi-bot polling/fan-out |

## Recommendation

Hold off on this sync until PR #31 is decided. When ready, this doc lists every commit worth porting.
